# std.uuid

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

UUIDs as their hyphenated lower-case text: random (version 4) and
time-ordered (version 7, sortable by creation). Reproduction bundles
record the new ones, so a replay repeats them.
